Loading a nonexistent language should produce an error.

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { process } from "@xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack-wasm";
function main() {
try {
    process("", { language: "nonexistent_xyz" });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(String(error));
  }
}

void main();
```
